target.title: add whatsapp outbound token diagnostics
target.body:
## Summary

Improves diagnostics for proactive WhatsApp Web 1:1 sends to contacts that may not have an existing conversation with the account.

Practically, this targets a failure mode where OpenClaw/Baileys reports a message as sent, but WhatsApp never actually delivers it to the recipient. This can happen with new WhatsApp numbers or cold 1:1 conversations when WhatsApp requires trusted-contact token state or has an active reachout timelock.

## Use case

When an agent sends a WhatsApp message to a new contact, OpenClaw should not silently appear successful if WhatsApp Web is blocked from delivering that message.

This change makes that state easier to detect:

- attempts USync before sending to discover and persist PN/LID mappings
- checks trusted-contact token state for direct 1:1 sends
- logs useful diagnostics when the token is missing
- throws a clear error before `sendMessage` when reachout timelock is active

## Behavior

- resolves phone-number targets to LID via USync when possible
- persists forward and reverse LID mapping files in the auth dir
- checks the `tctoken` store before direct 1:1 message sends
- logs missing trusted-contact token diagnostics
- fails early when reachout timelock is active, instead of letting the send look accepted while WhatsApp never actually delivers it

## Tests

- `pnpm tsgo:test:extensions`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-whatsapp.config.ts whatsapp/src/inbound/send-api.test.ts`
